item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a 2024 positive record of protection, amnesties, anti-torture reforms, or releases of political detainees. I also did not find reliable evidence of extrajudicial killings or disappearances in the narrow 2024 sources checked; the main documented harms were arrests, prosecutions, detention, and sentencing. Much of the detailed reporting is from rights groups and Reuters coverage of arrests and trials, not internal state admissions.
